items.title: Ashraful no longer Bangladesh's batting coach

items.title: Ashraful removed from batting coach's role
items.summary: ‎In a surprising development, Bangladesh batting coach Mohammad Ashraful was removed from his position by the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Saturday.

items.title: Bangladesh A in tough group in Asia Cup Rising Stars

items.title: Afghanistan U-19 deny Bangladesh series victory
items.summary: Bangladesh had won the opening match by 33 runs before clinching the second via a Super Over. Afghanistan bounced back with a 43-run victory in the third game before drawing level in the series with Friday's win.

items.title: BCB announces free entry to select galleries for first Ban-WI Test
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Friday announced that spectators will be able to watch the first Test between Bangladesh and West Indies at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur free of charge from designated galleries.
